subject: Pilot Readiness Checklist & Commitments — Lumos Health
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reynolds <alex.reynolds@lumoshealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot Readiness Checklist & Commitments — Lumos Health

Alex — thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap of what we heard, what success looks like, and a proposed set of commitments to keep the pilot moving. Please confirm or correct any items below.

Key pain points you shared:
- Latency spikes on batch inference affecting clinician workflows during peak hours (3–5pm PT).
- High per-token cost from current vendor on embedding-heavy search flows.
- Compliance requirement: logs retained for 12 months and VPC isolation for PHI-adjacent payloads.

Primary pilot goals (what success looks like):
1) Reduce median inference tail latency (95th percentile) by >= 40% for the triage flow.
2) Demonstrate 30% cost reduction per embedding query at production-like throughput.
3) Validate data isolation and audit log surface to meet internal security checklist.

Confirmed stakeholders (please correct if wrong):
- Alex Reynolds (Clinical Product, Lumos) — primary PD contact / decision maker for feature acceptance
- Terry Nguyen (Procurement, Lumos) — procurement and contract lead (Alex to introduce)
- Monica Patel (Redwood) — pilot owner / commercial
- Sean Gallagher (Redwood) — delivery lead / SOW & ops
- Rafael Mendes (Redwood) — technical lead for integration/kickoff

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (high level) — please treat this as a living checklist: 
- Milestone A — Scope & success metrics sign-off
  Owner: Alex Reynolds
  Target date: 2027-04-15
  Deliverable: signed checklist doc (we attached v1)

- Milestone B — Technical pre-check & VPC networking review
  Owner: Rafael Mendes (Redwood) + Lumos infra rep (TBD)
  Target date: 2027-04-22
  Deliverable: network diagram + firewall rules checklist

- Milestone C — Pilot deployment & smoke tests (staging)
  Owner: Sean Gallagher (Redwood)
  Target date: 2027-05-06
  Deliverable: staging report (latency/cost baselines)

- Milestone D — Business review & go/no-go decision
  Owner: Alex Reynolds + Terry Nguyen (procurement)
  Target date: 2027-05-20
  Deliverable: acceptance email or signed MOU (if moving to Dedicated capacity)

Open questions / constraints we flagged:
- Will Lumos require a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) before any test data leaves your VPC? (Procurement asks)
- Expected concurrency during peak hours (helpful for batch sizing) — you mentioned ~120 concurrent triage requests; please confirm.
- Any mandatory security evidence (SOC2 report, pen-test) that procurement will need before the go/no-go?

Next steps from our side (Redwood):
- Attach v1 checklist & MAP (see attachments) for your review — I’ll update once you confirm stakeholders and dates.
- Rafael to schedule the network pre-check (proposed window 2027-04-18 to 2027-04-20) — Rafael, will do you have availability?
- Sean will prepare a draft SOW outline for pilot scope and estimated costs (will share by 2027-04-12).

Please reply with any corrections and confirm who from Lumos should be on the network call (and/or cc Terry so procurement is looped). If the dates above don't work, propose alternates and we'll adapt.

Attachments: RINF-Pilot-Readiness-Checklist-v1.pdf; MAP-draft-Lumos-20270407.xlsx

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0184

Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot Readiness Checklist & Commitments — Lumos Health

Monica — thanks for the clear summary. Confirming a few items:
1) Decision timeline: procurement (Terry) needs to review the DPA and SOC2 evidence — likely a 2-week review once we have materials. Terry, I’ve cc'd you.
2) Concurrency: our triage peak is closer to 140 concurrent requests during episodic surges — sorry I quoted the low end earlier.
3) Network call: please include our infra lead, Priya Shah (priya.shah@lumoshealth.com). She can join the 18th or 19th.

On the MAP: the dates look reasonable; we're aiming to reach Milestone D by 2027-05-20 but procurement review could push that out a week or two.

I'll loop Terry on outstanding security evidence and ask procurement for a short list of mandatory docs.

—Alex
